primary_endpoint: Percentage of participants with an adjudicated clinical outcome composite event, up to 7 years.
efficacy_outcome: Events: OCA 10 mg 15.8%, OCA 25 mg 14.7%, placebo 18.8%; p=0.1028 and p=0.0444, respectively (log-rank).
safety_signal: Serious AEs: OCA 10 mg 273/825 (14 deaths), OCA 25 mg 276/827 (19 deaths), placebo 248/825 (14 deaths).
